title: Pinned-SHA baseline snapshot
description: Typed snapshot of repo, branches, worktrees, live deployments, caches, plugin settings, marketplaces, hooks, skills, and MCPs. Every captured field declares x-anchoring SHA-ANCHORED or SAMPLED-AT-TIME. A SHA-ANCHORED count is read from git ls-tree / cat-file at pinned_sha so the artifact can be a rollback anchor. A field that cannot be recovered from the commit is SAMPLED-AT-TIME and must carry sampled_at. kind is itself a sample: BASELINE only when HEAD equals pinned_sha and the worktree is porcelain-clean.

kind.description: Quiescence label, not a git-tree fact. BASELINE means HEAD==pinned_sha and git status --porcelain is empty. Concurrent dirt, extra untracked files, or a detached/mismatched HEAD force SAMPLE.

captured_at.description: UTC timestamp of this capture wall-clock. Identical SHA recaptures may differ here without changing SHA-ANCHORED fields.

pinned_sha.description: Commit object id the SHA-ANCHORED counts were read at. Null when the worktree has no git database (NOT-CHECKED).

tree_sha.description: git rev-parse <pinned_sha>^{tree}. Identifies the tree object independently of the commit wrapper.

files.description: Map of tracked posix path to blob SHA from git ls-tree -r --full-tree at pinned_sha. Working-tree bytes are never the oracle.

repo.description: Whole-tree tracked file census at pinned_sha (ls-tree blob count + blob map).

hooks_tree.description: Tracked paths under hooks/ at pinned_sha. An untracked hook must not change this count.

skills_tree.description: Tracked paths under skills/ at pinned_sha.

mcps_tree.description: Tracked paths under mcp/ plus .mcp.json at pinned_sha.

plugin_settings_tree.description: Tracked paths under plugins/ at pinned_sha.

marketplaces_tree.description: Tracked paths under marketplaces/ at pinned_sha.

branches.description: Local branch refs (git for-each-ref refs/heads). Extra branches at the same commit are live-state, not tree facts.

worktrees.description: git worktree list --porcelain. Linked worktrees are host state.

live_deployments.description: Files under top-level dist/build/deploy/.deploy/site. Deploy artifacts are not recovered from the commit tree by this enumerator.

caches.description: Files under cache-named directories (.cache, __pycache__, node_modules, ...). Untracked cache blobs must not move SHA-ANCHORED counts.

plugin_settings_live.description: Worktree walk of plugins/, including untracked files.

marketplaces_live.description: Worktree walk of marketplaces/, including untracked files.

hooks_live.description: Worktree walk of hooks/. This is the control that moves when an untracked hook is planted; hooks_tree must not.

skills_live.description: Worktree walk of skills/, including untracked files.

mcps_live.description: Worktree walk of mcp/ plus .mcp.json if present.

anchoredObject.description: Count object whose count/paths/blobs come from git ls-tree at pinned_sha. sampled_at is forbidden: a timestamp would pretend a tree fact was a sample.

sampled_at.description: UTC sample timestamp required because this count cannot be SHA-anchored.
